fields.summary: This amendment keeps Syserco, Inc. providing support services for the Buildings & Grounds Department, including preventative maintenance software and cyber security updates for its building automation system. It adds $355,240 and extends the contract from June 30, 2024 to June 30, 2027. The text says the contract limit goes from $230,227 to $565,467, but those figures do not add up; $230,227 plus $355,240 is $585,467.

24-0914.note: The new contract total was corrected from the printed $565,467 to $585,467, the sum of the stated prior total and the amount added.
24-0914.sourceIssue: The official text's numbers don't add up: $230,227 plus $355,240 is $585,467, but it states a new total of $565,467.
